analysisLimit: No catalog endpoint exists in this build, so there is no catalog to map: server lists only arrive as user-supplied V2Ray/Xray subscription URLs. The subscription mechanism is reproduced locally by xveon_catalog.py (plain GET + Base64/plain URI list, FAILED when nothing parseable) and is NOT wired into the repo: the worker never fetches a user-supplied URL.

dependencies.sharedSourceNote: xveon.py is the original decoder, kept verbatim (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 10k + AES-256-GCM + GZIP JSON envelope). file_decoder.py is only a thin worker adapter (decode/run/decode_text + CLI) over it. Either `cryptography` or `pycryptodome` satisfies AES-GCM; the repo pins pycryptodome 3.23.0.

files.validation: Real xveontunnel:// link from Pedro opens (VERIFIED_REAL, v2 envelope, 1 SSH profile); xveon:// and xvn:// prefixes and .xveon/.xvn files are VERIFIED_SYNTHETIC (same 5-part string, round-trip encode -> file -> decode). No real .xveon file has been supplied yet.

icon.policy: Exact original PNG bytes; app icon foreground (res/rj.png) on the app background #272846; no redraw, conversion or resize.

name: XVEON Tunnel Pro

subscription.mechanism: User-supplied V2Ray/Xray subscription URL only; no built-in catalog, no fixed endpoint, no auth headers.
subscription.note: xveon_catalog.py implements the app's real subscription fetch/parse and reports FAILED instead of inventing servers. It is NOT staged: no repo precedent wires a user-URL fetcher as a catalog, and the worker contract forbids network fetches.
